what: Step 2 — Define a custom pack constructor
title: Add a New Rule Pack
text: pack constructor : accept configuration (domain, thresholds, ownership), create one new_rule(...) objects, return plain list rules.
code: make_rule_pack_lab_custom <- function(domain = "LB",                                       owner_team = "Data Management",                                       hgb_min = 6,                                       hgb_max = 22) {   list(      # Rule 1: Hemoglobin plausibility window     new_rule(       id = "LAB001_HGB_OUT_OF_RANGE",       title = "Hemoglobin out of range",       topology = "A1",       scope = "record",       intent = "clinical_review",       domain = domain,       severity = "warning",       owner_team = owner_team,       fn = function(data, context, rule) {         needed <- c("USUBJID", "LBTESTCD", "LBSTRESN")         if (!all(needed %in% names(data))) return(data.frame())          testcd <- as.character(data$LBTESTCD)         value <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(data$LBSTRESN))         bad <- testcd == "HGB" & !is.na(value) & (value < hgb_min | value > hgb_max)         if (!any(bad)) return(data.frame())          data[bad, c("USUBJID", "LBTESTCD", "LBSTRESN"), drop = FALSE]       }     ),      # Rule 2: Result unit should be present when result is present     new_rule(       id = "LAB002_RESULT_WITHOUT_UNIT",       title = "Result present without unit",       topology = "A1",       scope = "record",       intent = "data_entry",       domain = domain,       severity = "error",       owner_team = owner_team,       fn = function(data, context, rule) {         needed <- c("USUBJID", "LBTESTCD", "LBORRES", "LBORRESU")         if (!all(needed %in% names(data))) return(data.frame())          result_present <- !is.na(data$LBORRES) & nzchar(as.character(data$LBORRES))         unit_missing <- is.na(data$LBORRESU) | !nzchar(as.character(data$LBORRESU))         bad <- result_present & unit_missing         if (!any(bad)) return(data.frame())          data[bad, c("USUBJID", "LBTESTCD", "LBORRES", "LBORRESU"), drop = FALSE]       }     ),      # Rule 3: Duplicate test on same date for same subject     new_rule(       id = "LAB003_DUP_SUBJECT_TEST_DATE",       title = "Duplicate subject/test/date",       topology = "A1",       scope = "record",       intent = "ops_anomaly",       domain = domain,       severity = "warning",       owner_team = owner_team,       fn = function(data, context, rule) {         needed <- c("USUBJID", "LBTESTCD", "LBDTC")         if (!all(needed %in% names(data))) return(data.frame())          keys <- data[, needed, drop = FALSE]         dup <- duplicated(keys) | duplicated(keys, fromLast = TRUE)         if (!any(dup)) return(data.frame())          data[dup, needed, drop = FALSE]       }     )   ) }

Default "SITEID". numeric_vars Character vector numeric variables include statistical checks (R034, R035, R037, R038, R039). non_negative_vars Variables must contain negative values (R033). value_ranges Named list two-element numeric vectors specifying hard c(min, max) bounds R031 (e.g. list(AGE = c(0, 120), WEIGHT = c(1, 600))). visit_order_var Numeric variable used order records within subject R037 (e.g. "ADY" "VISITNUM"). max_within_change Named list maximum permitted consecutive change per numeric variable R037 (e.g. list(AVAL = 100)). Variables absent list skipped. iqr_multiplier Multiplier applied IQR define outer fence R035. Default 3.0 (Tukey far-rule). zero_rate_threshold Fraction non-missing values zero R034 fires. Default 0.5. low_cv_threshold Coefficient variation R038 flags suspiciously low variance. Default 0.01. round_rate_threshold Fraction values divisible 5 R039 fires. Default 0.9. owner_team Team assigned follow flagged records. ... Reserved future extensions; currently ignored.
